_sampling_split_note: D006/S3 (C4, Call 3): three-way build/val/test. temperature is deduplicated by VALUE then round-robin interleaved over sorted values -- a contiguous split would make pool membership partly predictable from temperature alone (D005/M2). do_sample stays shared across all pools per the A5 carve-out: with 2 distinct values any disjoint split puts all-greedy in one pool and all-stochastic in another, a worse confound than the leakage it removes.
